step1_figure.circuit_type: Comparator preamplification and positive feedback decision circuit
step1_figure.description: Figure 27.5 shows the schematic of the differential input pre-amplifier (M1-M2 with PMOS active loads M31, M41, and current mirror outputs M3, M4) driving the cross-coupled positive feedback decision circuit (M5-M8).

high_switching_point_voltage.description: Positive input switching threshold voltage (VSPH) at which the comparator decision circuit changes state when increasing vp relative to vm

equation.explanation: Calculates the upper input differential switching voltage resulting from positive feedback hysteresis. If beta_B = beta_A, VSPH = 0 (no hysteresis). For beta_B > beta_A (e.g. beta_B / beta_A = 1.2), hysteresis is exhibited.
equation.assumptions: M1-M2 are in saturation, Iss is fully switched between the branches, and beta_B >= beta_A

sky130_expected.calculation: For SKY130 with Iss = 40 uA and diff-pair M1, M2 having (W/L) = 10u / 1u: gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (Iss/2)) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = sqrt(1.08e-7) = 328.6 uA/V. If beta_B = beta_A (symmetric design as in Fig 27.5), VSPH = 0 V. If sized with beta_B / beta_A = 1.2 (as in Example 27.1), VSPH = (40 uA / 328.6 uA/V) * (0.2 / 2.2) = 121.7 mV * 0.0909 = 11.06 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: For equal transistor sizing (W5=W6=W7=W8), the switching threshold is nominally 0 V (no hysteresis). With intentional sizing mismatch (e.g. 1.2 ratio), it is around 11-24 mV.

low_switching_point_voltage.description: Negative input switching threshold voltage (VSPL) at which the comparator switches when vp decreases relative to vm

equation.explanation: Due to circuit symmetry, the lower switching point voltage is equal in magnitude and opposite in sign to the upper switching point voltage.
equation.assumptions: Fully symmetric pre-amp and decision circuit branches

sky130_expected.calculation: For symmetric sizing (beta_B = beta_A), VSPL = -0 V = 0 V. For beta_B/beta_A = 1.2, VSPL = -VSPH = -11.06 mV.

hysteresis_voltage.description: Total input hysteresis voltage window (VHYST = VSPH - VSPL)

equation.explanation: Difference between upper and lower switching thresholds of the decision stage.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric upper and lower threshold behavior

sky130_expected.calculation: For beta_B = beta_A: V_HYST = 0 V. For beta_B/beta_A = 1.2: V_HYST = 2 * 11.06 mV = 22.1 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Default design has beta_A = beta_B producing zero nominal hysteresis.

maximum_output_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage of the decision stage when one side conducts full current (iop >> iom)

equation.explanation: When M1 is fully on and M2 is off, iop carries the mirrored tail current (Iss). The gate-to-source voltage of diode-connected M5 sets the maximum output voltage.
equation.assumptions: iop = Iss, M6 and M8 are completely cut off

sky130_expected.calculation: With Iss = 40 uA, beta_A = un*Cox*(W5/L5) = 270 uA/V^2 * (10u/1u) = 2.7 mA/V^2: Vov = sqrt(2 * 40u / 2.7m) = sqrt(0.0296) = 0.172 V. Thus v_op_max = 0.172 V + 0.42 V = 0.592 V (or ~0.65-0.85 V including body effect / subthreshold).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Set by diode-connected NMOS overdrive voltage plus Vth at 40 uA load.

minimum_output_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage of the decision stage (vom when iop >> iom)

equation.explanation: When M8 is off and M7 pulls vom toward ground with zero current sourced from M4, vom drops close to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: With M4 in subthreshold/cutoff and cross-coupled M7 turned on by vop, vom is pulled down near ground (~50 mV to 150 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Leakage and non-zero on-resistance of NMOS pull-down set the low level slightly above 0V.

decision_output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output swing of the decision circuit (vop_max - vop_min)

equation.explanation: The limited voltage swing at the decision nodes vop and vom allows high switching speed.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker notes in Ex 27.1 that the amplitudes of vop and vom are limited to maintain speed.

equation.explanation: Tail current sourced by NMOS xmsu3 biased by Vbiasn from SUB_1.

sky130_expected.calculation: SUB_1 provides reference current set by R1 (6.5k) and mirrored to xmsu3, targeting ~40 uA nominal Iss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard textbook design operating point is Iss = 40 uA.

static_power_dissipation.description: Total static DC power consumption of the preamplifier and decision circuit

equation.explanation: Total current from VDD includes the bias generator SUB_1, the differential preamplification pair (Iss), and the decision load branches.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pre-amp draws Iss (40 uA), decision loads mirror Iss (40 uA), bias block SUB_1 draws ~80 uA. Total current ~160 uA. Power = 1.8 V * 160 uA = 288 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of currents through all branches from VDD at 1.8 V.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to characterize the preamplifier and decision circuit (Fig 27.5): measures tail current, static power, switching thresholds (VSPH, VSPL), hysteresis, and output swing under DC sweep.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Comparator Preamp and Decision Circuit (Baker Fig. 27.5)
.lib "/path/to/sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameter definitions
.param W_xmsu3=20u L_xmsu3=1u
.param W_xm31=30u  L_xm31=1u
.param W_xm41=30u  L_xm41=1u
.param W_xm2=10u   L_xm2=1u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=1u
.param W_xm3=30u   L_xm3=1u
.param W_xm4=30u   L_xm4=1u
.param W_xm5=10u   L_xm5=1u
.param W_xm6=10u   L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=10u   L_xm7=1u
.param W_xm8=10u   L_xm8=1u

* SUB_1 Bias generator parameters
.param W_xmsu2=20u L_xmsu2=1u
.param W_xmsu1=10u L_xmsu1=1u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Input Sources
* Common-mode level is 0.9 V
Vp vp 0 0.9
Vm vm 0 0.9

* Circuit Under Test (DUT)
xmsu3 N003 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm31 N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm31} l={L_xm31}
xm41 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm41} l={L_xm41}
xm2 N001 vm N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm1 N002 vp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
X_U1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD 0 SUB_1
xm3 vop N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 vom N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm5 vop vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 vop vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 vom vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 vom vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

.subckt SUB_1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD GND
  xmsu2 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
  xmsu1 N001 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
  xmsu3 VDD N001 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
  xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm4 Vbiasp Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Vbiasp Vbiasn N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  R1 N002 GND 6.5k
.ends SUB_1

.control
* 1. Operating Point Analysis
op
let iss_val = -i(VDD)
let power_val = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print iss_val power_val

* 2. DC Sweep Analysis for Forward Transition (increasing vp)
dc Vp 0.8 1.0 0.0005
let diff_out = v(vop) - v(vom)
let v_diff_in = v(vp) - 0.9

meas dc vop_max max v(vop)
meas dc vom_min min v(vom)
let swing = vop_max - vom_min
print swing

* Switching threshold: where vop crosses vom
meas dc vsph_abs when v(vop)=v(vom) rise=1
let vsph = vsph_abs - 0.9
print vsph

* 3. DC Sweep Analysis for Reverse Transition (decreasing vp)
dc Vp 1.0 0.8 -0.0005
meas dc vspl_abs when v(vop)=v(vom) fall=1
let vspl = vspl_abs - 0.9
print vspl

let vhyst = vsph - vspl
print vhyst

quit
.endc
.end
